faqLeft.q: What engine does the Jaguar S-Type R use?
faqLeft.a: The S-Type R uses the supercharged 4.2-litre AJ-V8 across its entire 1999–2008 production run.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Jaguar S-Type R engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £5,500. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my S-Type R?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm your exact AJ-V8 supercharged specification before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild AJ-V8 supercharged S-Type R engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace the timing chain, tensioners, and guide rails as standard on every S-Type R rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used S-Type R engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my S-Type R if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an S-Type R engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most S-Type R owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.

form.guarantee: Most quotes returned within 30 minutes during working hours.
